forensics.metaDescription: KaZaA - Media search community, lets you find music, movies, pictures, documents and applications, and download these directly to your computer. KaZaA works differently from traditional search engines such as Yahoo! and AltaVista, and produces much more relevant results for media content. Where traditional search engines search the World Wide Web, KaZaA searches tens of thousands of computers at once, all connected through a distributed peer-to-peer file-sharing network with no centralised server. KaZaA is available in nine languages - English, Danish, Dutch, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Swedish, and Japanese.

Eschewing traditional search engines, it offered a decentralized approach to finding music, movies, and applications, available in nine languages. The service was captured from 2000 to 2021.
ghostPersona: I remember myself as the vibrant hub of a new media experience, a place where you could instantly find and download your favorite music, movies, and documents. I thrived on the power of a distributed peer-to-peer network, connecting tens of thousands of computers without a central server, making traditional search engines seem obsolete for media content. My community was global, speaking nine languages, always promising to amaze you with what you could discover.
